lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical lines with approximately uniform spacing of 25-30 pixels in the mid-torso, narrowing at the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal origin of the 6th vertical line from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 3rd, 9th, and 10th vertical lines exhibit abbreviated topologies, terminating at the mid-lateral line rather than traversing the full torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, with a density of approximately 1 spot per 15 square pixels in that region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial 45-degree lateral vector from the skull, transitioning to a medial-posterior spiral at the apical section.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 12-15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the medial orbital regions and two high-contrast white spots on the lower mandibular region.
